summary.text: Johanny Cepeda-Freytiz is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 129 who has served since December 1, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She is a restaurant owner and a former president of the Reading City Council.

paragraphs.text: Johanny Cepeda-Freytiz earned a B.A. from the State University of New York at New Paltz in 1996 and an M.S. in education from Long Island University in 2007.
Her career experience includes owning a restaurant, and she has served as president of the Reading City Council.
Cepeda-Freytiz assumed office on December 1, 2022, succeeding Jim Cox.
For the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments as Finance, Gaming Oversight, and Tourism & Recreational Development.
